description: This file defines the class 'Image_Canvas_Color' which extends 'Image_Color' to handle color operations such as allocation, conversion to RGBA, generating color ranges, and setting colors, specifically for image processing within the 'Image_Canvas' package.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_Color
classes.description: A class extending 'Image_Color' to add RGBA handling, color allocation, range generation, and internal color setting for image processing.

methods.name: allocateColor
methods.description: Allocates a color in a GD image resource, supporting alpha transparency if available.

methods.name: color2RGB
methods.description: Converts various color representations (array, string) into an RGBA array.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Generates a range of colors between two colors, including alpha channel interpolation.

methods.name: _setColors
methods.description: Sets internal color1 and color2 properties based on input colors.
